title: QUIZ - 91
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Reading Function Values from Multiple Graphed Points
questions.learningObjective: Read a specific function value from a graph showing multiple plotted points
questions.question: A graph passes through the points (-4, -1), (-3, -3), (-2, -5), (5, -19). What is g(-2)?
questions.explanation: The point (-2, -5) is on the graph, so g(-2) = -5.
questions.hint: Find the point on the graph whose x-coordinate matches the input, then read its y-coordinate.

questions.concept: Reading Function Values Directly from a Graph
questions.learningObjective: Read a function's value at a point directly from a graphed coordinate
questions.question: The graph of h shows the point (7, -9) lying on the curve. Based on this, what is h(7)?
questions.explanation: A point (a, b) on the graph of a function h means h(a) = b. Since (7, -9) is on the graph, h(7) = -9.
questions.hint: A point (a, b) on a function's graph means f(a) = b.

questions.concept: Reading Inputs from Function Graphs
questions.learningObjective: Determine the input value that produces a given output by reading a graphed point
questions.question: The graph of g passes through (6, 22). For what input value does g output 22?
questions.explanation: Since the point (6, 22) lies on the graph, g(6) = 22, so the input that produces output 22 is 6.
questions.hint: Look for the point on the graph whose y-coordinate matches the target output, then read its x-coordinate.
